summary.lv: SIA Remote Latvia meklē IoT Commercial Manager, kurš/-a attīstīs IoT produktu komerciālo stratēģiju, identificēs jaunas biznesa iespējas un sadarbosies ar starptautiskiem klientiem.
summary.en: SIA Remote Latvia seeks an IoT Commercial Manager to develop commercial IoT product strategy, identify new business opportunities, and collaborate with international clients in a tech-savvy role.
